body:
A reader writes:

 I wanted to say that I believe your book is one of the most important I have read and is an eloquent prospectus for the future of Christianity. You have captured so well so much of what I have been thinking over these past few years (influenced by Rohr, Borg, Delio, Bell, Spong and others). I have no doubt that this will apply to many others and that your writing represents the future – and that, indeed, our species’ survival may depend on how Christianity adapts in the next few years.
